limits: No benchmarks; one 77.5% accuracy run with unstated dataset size, measured against GPT-4 labels rather than human labels.
Code uses legacy APIs (pydantic.v1, chat(messages=), create_extraction_chain_pydantic, load_summarize_chain, gpt-3.5-turbo-1106/0613, function role messages).
Text says LangChain prompt saving may not work for all template types.
Authors state load_summarize_chain has newer LCEL alternatives.

practices: Use SystemMessage for explicit directions (Chat Models note).
Use .batch() with RunnableConfig max_concurrency to parallelise requests; async variants are prefixed a (Creating Multiple LLM Generations).
Use prompt templates instead of f-strings to validate inputs, compose, select k-shot examples, and save/load (LangChain Prompt Templates).
Use the Pydantic output parser with get_format_instructions and handle edge cases and errors (Output Parsers).
Define eval metrics so prompt changes can be judged; test a cheaper model against GPT-4 labels and try an external API before self-hosting (LangChain Evals).
Manually review pairwise-judge reasoning, since GPT-4 may judge badly where it is bad at the task (LangChain Evals).
Define a detailed JSON schema for function calling and be explicit in the system message because parameters can be hallucinated (OpenAI Function Calling).
Use query planning to turn multi-intent queries into a dependency graph (Query Planning).
Use LengthBasedExampleSelector with a tiktoken length function to stay in the context window (Selecting Few-Shot Examples by Length).
If few-shot overfits, rephrase, tell the model to use examples for format only, or fine-tune (Limitations with Few-Shot Examples).
No perfect chunk size: start with heuristics and build a test set for evaluation (Text Splitters note).
Decompose tasks into chains; use a smart model for ideation and a cheap one for generation (Prompt Chaining, Divide Labor).
Pick the document-chain strategy (stuff, refine, map reduce, map re-rank) using Table 4-1.

terms.definition: The | pipe operator ... allows you to chain together different components or runnables in a data processing pipeline.
A higher-level abstraction provided by LangChain for parsing structured data from LLM string responses.
Chat messages include intents that request simultaneous calls to multiple tools.
Parsing a user's query into a series of steps that can be executed as a query graph with relevant dependencies.
The strategic process of dissecting complex problems into a suite of manageable subproblems.

terms.term: Stuff / Refine / Map Reduce / Map Re-rank
terms.definition: Four document-chain strategies: insert all documents in one request; iteratively update output per document; map an LLM chain over documents then combine; score each answer by confidence and return the best.
